title: "A game for everyone is a game for no one": Don't expect an easy ride in Carcass Clad, the co-op tank horror game from the makers of Mouthwashing
description: On my final day of Gamescom, strolling (running) around the indie area to make sure I don't miss anything good, I stumble upon Wrong Organ’s upcoming Carcass Clad. Set in a wartorn Soviet city, empty of people but littered with tanks wearing coats of Frankensteined cattle corpses (light stuff!), Carcass Clad is a three-player co-op experience that shares the stressful responsibility of piloting a tank and taking down enemy units between those unlucky three. If you read the name Wrong Organ and thought, ‘Wait, the Mouthwashing team? They're making a multiplayer co-op game?’, I can't fault your surprise. Edwin did interview them about it back in June, but I walked up to the booth knowing the devs themselves and little more, so I was experiencing all of Carcass Clad and its heavy departure from their previous work for the first time. Read more

title: How does Epic Games CEO Tim Sweeney reckon we can fight the industry's "Crash 2.0"? By building more factories
description: It's pretty obvious to anyone that's been paying attention that the games industry is in a pretty rough place at the moment. No matter where you look, there are mass layoffs: Sony, Microsoft, EA, Ubisoft, Take-Two, Epic Games … the list goes on. The reasons are myriad, but generally companies place the reason for 'restructuring' at the door of the contraction of the market as a result of the pandemic boom in gaming, rising development costs, longer production cycles (and higher wages), shifts in consumers spending patterns, and the hardware shortages fuelled by the rising demand for AI data centers around the world. title: Dave Bautista Shows Off His Transformation Into God Of War’s Kratos
description: After Ryan Hurst was seriously injured during the filming of the God of War TV show, Dave Bautista was announced to replace him and take on the role of Kratos. Now, the Guardians of the Galaxy star and former professional wrestler has shared his training for the role. Posting on Instagram, Bautista captioned the video "3rd week in to weight training again. 2 more months to get to where I need to be. Like ridin a bike! LFG!" This indicates there are around two months before God of War filming will recommence. After bulking up to play Leonard in M. Night Shyamalan's Knock at the Cabin, Bautista lost most of the weight he put on. However, it seems he's pivoting back in order to play Kratos in the upcoming Amazon adaptation, much like Ryan Hurst did prior to his injury. Previously, there were reports that production would resume in mid-October, but given Bautista's Instagram caption, it seems like that's late October or early November. Alongside Bautista, the TV show cast will star Ólafur Darri Ólafsson as Thor, Teresa Palmer as Sif, and Callum Vinson as Atreus, among many others. The adaptation follows some of the events of 2018's God of War and 2022's God of War Ragnarok, telling the story of father and son Kratos and Atreus. Prime Video is also making the live-action Tomb Raider TV show starring Sophie Turner, although production was also temporarily halted earlier this year following Turner's on-set injury.

title: There's already a The Blood of Dawnwalker mod which triples the length of its main quest timer, ensuring saving your family from vampires isn't stressful

The good news for folks who don't like even the vague idea that they need to get a move on in their hero duties is that Dawnwalker's taken less than a day to get a mod which substantially lengthens its 30-day family saving timer. title: 15 Things You Need To Know Before You Play The Blood Of Dawnwalker
description: Are you looking for The Blood of Dawnwalker tips? This is an open-world RPG made by the talented folks who, once upon a time, helped with the development of The Witcher 3. You can expect everything from macabre creatures and dark fantasy themes, as well as unique mechanics that are totally refreshing for the genre. Of course, it goes without saying that things can get a tad bit confusing at first, which is why our guide aims to assist you for the long road ahead. You’re a Dawnwalker - A part-human, part-vampire hybrid In The Blood of Dawnwalker, you play as Coen, a commoner from a small village called Laslea Glen. Circumstances have not only caused Coen’s family to get kidnapped by vampire lords known as vrakhiri. He’s also been turned into a monstrosity--a dawnwalker--someone who lives as a human by day and turns into a vampire at night. This dynamic changes how you approach the game. During the day, you heal up normally by eating food and you chat with shopkeepers who ply their craft in settlements. You may also cast Witchcraft spells and commune with the spirits of the dead. You’re basically a warrior-spellcaster with the limitations of being human. Just a medieval warrior hunting for wolves. Learn to manage your bloodthirst as a vampire Things change drastically at night. As a vampire, you need to satisfy your bloodthirst. This means feeding on hapless stragglers and wildlife. If your health is too low and you approach a person, you might lose control, causing you to bleed them dry as you feast. That said, being a lord of the night has its perks. You get to use serrated claws to strike foes. You get to teleport across short distances. And, yes, you can even walk vertically on walls, defying gravity and all that is holy. Related guide: How to heal as a vampire Drink the blood of your enemies (left), and be ready if you're about to lose control (right). Carefully discern how activities impact Time Progression One of the most important Blood of Dawnwalker tips to…

title: You Can Give Up In The Blood Of Dawnwalker And Leave Vale Sangora For Good
description: Most video games encourage you to keep trying. Even when all seems lost or when a challenge feels insurmountable, every failure is just part of the learning curve. But The Blood of Dawnwalker, from developer Rebel Wolves and publisher Bandai Namco, eschews that age-old mantra. Instead, it has a joke ending where you simply give up on the campaign and leave the game world forever. In This Article How to leave Vale Sangora in The Blood of Dawnwalker Crossing the chasm From hero to zero How to leave Vale Sangora in The Blood of Dawnwalker You can leave Vale Sangora in The Blood of Dawnwalker as soon as you’re done with the prologue. When you’re ready, simply make your way from Laslea Glen to the western edge of the map. Just past the woods in Briar Sloughs, you’ll see an aptly named Shrine called the Coward’s Path. Travel along the road and you’ll stumble upon a side quest known as The Cursed Chasm. There, you’ll spot a broken bridge and a ravine. If you look across the gap, you’ll notice that the road continues all the way to a large gate that hasn’t been blockaded yet. A map showing the location of the exit gate. Crossing the chasm To get this joke ending in The Blood of Dawnwalker, you have to reach the gate at the end of the path. But, before you could do that, you have to get across the chasm first: Make sure it’s nighttime so that Coen turns into a vampire. Jump across and spam the Shadowstep button so you can latch on a rock at the opposite side. Then, with a combination of Planeshift and Shadowstep, climb to the other side of the ravine. When you approach the gate, pick [Leave the valley forever]. Cross the ravine (left) and escape the valley (right). From hero to zero Coen will admit that he has to find a new home and make a new life for himself. He won’t rescue his family anymore and he’ll leave the rest of the region under the rule of the vampire boyars. The credits will then play, though you’ll also see a quick epilogue that sets up a potential sequel.…

title: What Should You Do With The Font Of Life In The Blood Of Dawnwalker?
description: Are you scratching your head about the Font of Life in The Blood of Dawnwalker? This magical relic holds untold power, enough to cure all ills and revitalize one’s body. But you have to decide who gets it: Coen, Anca, or no one. Our guide, which tackles the Where Old Devils Die and Stronger Than Achilles quests, has all the details for you. In This Article Where Old Devils Die Stronger Than Achilles Who gets The Font of Life: Coen, Anca, or no one? Where Old Devils Die The Font of Life in The Blood of Dawnwalker comes into play near the end of the Stronger Than Achilles quest, which is actually part of Anca’s narrative arc. Here’s a quick summary: After leaving Laslea Glen, you can meet up with Anca at the Crossroads Inn. You should complete the Echoes of Silenced Bells quest as soon as you’re able to. A quest called Where Old Devils Die should pop up in your journal. After a day or so, return to Anca once she’s deciphered the writings. Examine the map and look at the eastern points-of-interest. Then, travel to the marked location with Anca. The couple will see an ancient door that only opens for someone who is imbued by numerous runes on their body. Tell Anca that you’re ready and she’ll start painting the runes on Coen’s torso and arms. This nets you the Runic Enchantment, a legendary chestpiece: It grants magical damage reduction, damage against supernatural enemies, Witchcraft ability damage, and, most surprisingly, lifesteal from attacks. It doesn’t have any armor value at all, and it also doesn’t have any weight. It’s basically a topless version of Coen whose body is covered in runes. The lack of armor shouldn’t be too much of an issue since you can heal up with the lifesteal effect from your attacks. Pinpoint the location of the ancient ruins (left) and eliminate the guardians of the tombs (right). Stronger Than Achilles The Blood of Dawnwalker Stronger Than Achilles quest is more straightforward: Move from one chamber to the next while taking out various…

title: How To Complete Echoes Of Silenced Bells In The Blood Of Dawnwalker
description: Are you planning to complete Echoes of Silenced Bells in The Blood of Dawnwalker? This side quest becomes available quite early in the campaign, though it’s up to you to decide when you ought to tackle it. We recommend doing this as soon as you’re able to, since it also leads to more quests and even a romance with your medic companion Anca. In This Article Echoes of Silenced Bells quest guide St. Tyna’s Convent Most Precious Thing and the Relic of St. Tyna How many times should you ring the bell? The library Leonica boss fight The notes in the fire and more books Echoes of Silenced Bells quest guide The Blood of Dawnwalker Echoes of Silenced Bells quest pops up in your journal as soon as you’re done with the prologue. Just as Coen is about to leave Laslea Glen, Anca tells him that they should meet up at the Crossroads Inn. The building is further southeast near the swamplands. It also has a Shrine, albeit one that’s damaged. We recommend repairing it by finding its heart, given that you’ll be fast traveling to this location frequently, especially if you plan on romancing Anca down the line. A map showing the location of the Crossroads Inn and St. Tyna's Convent. St. Tyna’s Convent St. Tyna’s Convent is just a stone’s throw away. With Anca alongside you, the mists should part, revealing an entrance into the facility. Things don’t go as planned, as Coen and Anca realize that the place is crawling with Zombie Nuns. Soon thereafter, you’ll find yourself in a building overlooking the courtyard. Examine your surroundings to learn the following: Your main goal is to secure safe passage for Anca heading to the library. This advances the quest and it costs 3x Time Segments. You may also check the infirmary and bell tower for clues. These actions don’t cost time segments. If you investigate the chapel, it’ll cost 1x Time Segment. There are a dozen Zombie Nuns in the courtyard. They won’t notice you immediately. But, once you get too close, they’ll turn hostile and it’ll be…

title: Following Nintendo's example, Sony and Microsoft argue they have no obligation to pass tariff refunds onto customers
description: Lawyers representing Sony and Microsoft have argued, in two separate lawsuits, that the platform holders are not obligated to pass tariff refunds back to consumers. Sony and Microsoft have had to raise prices of their PlayStation and Xbox consoles in 2025 in response to US-imposed tariffs. The US Supreme Court ruled the tariffs illegal earlier this year, allowing impacted companies to request refunds. Read more

title: PlayStation State Of Play September 2026: Start Time, How To Watch, And What To Expect
description: Just when you thought there would be a post-Gamescom break for video game livestreams, Sony dropped notice that the State of Play broadcast was returning with two back-to-back broadcasts. As usual, this will be a new look at upcoming PlayStation 5 games, but beyond that, Sony has revealed only a handful of details. If you're planning to watch, here's everything you need to know about when and where you can tune in. How to watch State of Play As usual, State of Play will be streamed live on Sony’s YouTube and Twitch channels. YouTube Twitch State of Play start time State of Play kicks off on September 3, at the following times: 6 AM PT 9 AM ET 3 PM CEST 10 PM JST What to expect The first State of Play broadcast will offer updates and announcements from PlayStation Studios and third-party partners. The livestream will close out with an extended look at Final Fantasy 7 Revelation, and immediately after, it'll be followed by a new episode of State of Play Japan. Hosted by Yuki Kaji, State of Play Japan will be focused entirely on upcoming games from game studios in Japan and Asia, so expect trailers and gameplay aplenty. September alone is packed with new releases, including the PS5-exclusive Marvel's Wolverine alongside Control Resonant, NBA 2K27, The Blood of Dawnwalker, and Onimusha: Way of the Sword, so new trailers for those games wouldn't be unlikely. Looking ahead to October, there are even more high-profile releases like Hellraiser: Revival, Castlevania: Belmont's Curse, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4, and Final Fantasy Resonance, just to name a few. And in November? There's that other game you might have heard of, Grand Theft Auto 6. If State of Play is going to be a reminder that there are far too many games still to come this year and not enough hours in the day to play them, it should still be a good show overall. What could make it even better is a closer look at other upcoming PS5 exclusives like Intergalactic: The Heretic Prophet and God of War Laufey,…

title: Where To Sell Your Silver Items In The Blood of Dawnwalker
description: Are you planning to sell silver in The Blood of Dawnwalker? With Vale Sangora under the rule of vampire lords, it’s no wonder that the sale of silver has been banned. Those who break the law are swiftly executed. Thankfully, there’s a fella that’s willing to pay you if you have the wares. In This Article Selling silver in The Blood of Dawnwalker Silver trader location Silver trader wares Selling silver in The Blood of Dawnwalker You’ll find all sorts of silver items while exploring the game world. Some are inside chests that you loot, while others are placed on shelves and tables, easy enough to steal when no one’s looking. Examples include bowls, crosses, chalices, jewelry, dining utensils, and even lumps of silver ore. Items made of silver net you a lot of cash. Silver trader location To sell silver in The Blood of Dawnwalker, you need to head to Svartrau City in the middle of the world map. Make your way to the southwestern part of the fortified settlement and look for the path that leads to Neustadt. Just past a couple of guards, you should spot a building. Go through the door and have a chat with the vendor. Svartrau City (left) has a vendor who's willing to buy your silver items (right). Silver trader wares You can part with all your silver goods in exchange for more denarii. Oh, and don’t forget to check the vendor’s wares. In our playthrough, this fella had three legendary items up for grabs: Legendary weapon: The Kingslayer Legendary amulet: Fear of the Wilds Legendary ring: Slicer’s Ring Note: If you want to get more cash when selling items, be sure to level up the Bewitching Influence perk in the Witchcraft tree. At level 2, it increases all selling prices by +15%. That does it for our guide on where to sell your silver in The Blood of Dawnwalker. We’re hoping that you can amass a ton of cash, enough to upgrade various weapons and armors, as well as purchase items that allow you to heal as a vampire.

title: All Scouting Towers In The Blood of Dawnwalker
description: Do you want to scale all the Scouting Towers in The Blood of Dawnwalker? These landmarks dot the countryside of Vale Sangora. Climbing them should be your priority since they reveal important info about your surroundings. Oh, and most locations have rewards inside chests, too. In This Article All Scouting Tower locations Tower 1: Church Tower Tower 2: Briar Sloughs Tower Tower 3: Maragir Wealds Tower Tower 4: Boar’s Back Tower Tower 5: Neustadt Tower Tower 6: Market Tower Tower 7: Cathedral Tower Tower 8: St. Tyna’s Grove Tower Tower 9: Tantari Tower Tower 10: Rockfalls Tower Tower 11: Silts Tower/Aurelius Tower All Scouting Tower locations There are 11 Scouting Towers in The Blood of Dawnwalker. Once you’re done with the prologue, you should be able to explore at your leisure. Here’s what you need to know: Scouting Towers can only be climbed when it’s nighttime. That’s because you need vampiric powers like Shadowstep and Planeshift to reach ledges and walk on walls. Upon climbing to the top of a tower, survey the landscape by pressing the button prompt on each spot. Doing so makes activities, locations, and points-of-interest appear on the world map. Don’t forget to loot any nearby containers while you’re at it. Most of these structures have manuals that allow you to learn new skills. Note: Scouting Towers do not cause time to progress. Because of this, we recommend prioritizing this activity as soon as you’re able to. If you’re up for it, you can actually tag all the towers in a single evening. These maps of the northern (left) and southern (right) sections of Vale Sangora show the locations of the Scouting Towers. Tower 1: Church Tower Location: It’s the very church where the Blood Mass took place during the prologue. Climb it once you’re able to use your vampiric traversal abilities. Reward: Aether Flow Manual Don't forget to climb the church in your home village. Tower 2: Briar Sloughs Tower Location: Head south upon exiting Laslea Glen. It’s near the river…

title: All Sacred Stones In The Blood of Dawnwalker – A Pilgrimage For Power Guide
description: Are you searching for the Sacred Stones in The Blood of Dawnwalker? These objects are part of a quest called A Pilgrimage for Power. Left behind by uriashi in ages long past, it’s up to you to discover the boons that they provide. In This Article A Pilgrimage for Power: Sacred Stone locations Sacred Stone 1: A Pilgrimage for Power - Bear Trouble Sacred Stone 2: A Pilgrimage for Power - Dark Thing Sacred Stone 3: A Pilgrimage for Power - Fanatics Sacred Stone 4: A Pilgrimage for Power - The Ritual Rewards: Ravenous Flock Manuals A Pilgrimage for Power: Sacred Stone locations While there are several uriashi structures with magical glyphs on them, The Blood of Dawnwalker Pilgrimage for Power quest only requires you to find four Sacred Stones. One is in the northern part of Vale Sangora, while the remaining three are in the southern reaches. Here are some additional tidbits: You can head to these locations regardless if it’s day or night. Your main goal is to follow the windchimes. Hold down the Focus button to see them more clearly. Interacting with the uriashi glyph itself causes two time segments to elapse. The reward from each glyph is a Ravenous Flock Manual. These are the Sacred Stones in the northern (left) and southern (right) parts of the world map. Sacred Stone 1: A Pilgrimage for Power - Bear Trouble Location: This will likely be the first Sacred Stone that you stumble upon in the campaign. It’s west of the Briar Sloughs Scouting Tower. Tip: Save your game once you reach the top of the plateau. You’re about to fight a Ravenous Bear soon. Once the bear is dead, check the uriashi corpse and dagger. Follow the windchimes (left) and be ready to take out a bear (right). Sacred Stone 2: A Pilgrimage for Power - Dark Thing Location: This Blood of Dawnwalker Sacred Stone is near the Westridge Outpost shrine. From the abandoned outpost, keep going north and climb the rocky crag. Tip: You’ll battle an Essence of Grief miniboss--i.e. Vidmo specter. When you’re done,…

title: How To Save Coen’s Mother In The Blood Of Dawnwalker
description: You definitely want to save Coen’s mother in The Blood of Dawnwalker. Esme was once protective of her four children. Unfortunately, due to the plague that ravaged the region and the arrival of the vampire boyars, she has since lost her will to live. She barely eats, causing her to weaken considerably. Now, it’s up to you to ensure her survival, lest the vampires find her existence no longer necessary. In This Article Withering Away - The quest to save Coen’s mother How to get the ingredients from Anca How to make the correct brew Esme’s fate Withering Away - The quest to save Coen’s mother To save Coen’s mother in The Blood of Dawnwalker, you must complete a prologue quest called Withering Away. It involves getting the ingredients and instructions from the herbalist, Anca, and then making the correct brew. Note: This whole process requires two to three Time Segments in the Time Bar, so make sure you have enough to spare before the day ends. How to get the ingredients from Anca You can find Anca in the southeastern part of Laslea Glen. Meet up with her by the river, then chat with her inside her hut. Pay Anca 50 denarii to buy the items. “I really have to go” - This costs 1x Time Segment. Coen leaves with the items. “Gladly. I’ve missed it too” - This costs 2x Time Segment instead. It leads to a short but sweet moment where Coen bonds with Anca. It’s worth seeing if you plan on romancing Anca later on. Anca has the ingredients you need. How to make the correct brew Of course, you still need to brew the potion if you want to save Coen’s mom in The Blood of Dawnwalker: This process costs 1x Time Segment. Before reentering your home, read the Instructions From Anca in your inventory. After the cutscene where Coen starts making the brew, pick “use hot water.” Followed by “three scoops.” Coen will feed Esme the stew, which contains the medicine. Note: After this, you can spar with Coen’s father to receive the Charge Manual and 100 XP. Don't mess up the stew. Esme’s fate…

Over a dozen of these landmarks dot the countryside of Vale Sangora and all of them allow you to summon vengeful spirits of the dead. Naturally, if you’re able to survive the onslaught, you can obtain some goodies. title: All Haunted Sites In The Blood Of Dawnwalker
description: Are you baffled by the locations of the Haunted Sites in The Blood of Dawnwalker? These eerie places are often littered with corpses. Although the villagers are long deceased, their spirits still linger and it’s up to you to exorcise them. Our guide has all the details to help you complete the objectives. In This Article Where to find all Haunted Sites in The Blood of Dawnwalker Haunted Site #1: Site of Crucifixion Haunted Site #2: Mass Grave Haunted Site #3: River Massacre Haunted Site #4: Destroyed Caravan Unholy Vitality and Soul Reaping rewards Where to find all Haunted Sites in The Blood of Dawnwalker There are four Haunted Sites in The Blood of Dawnwalker. Several are actually near the central regions of the map, though one is a bit further to the south. You can only exorcise spirits during the day and the action itself costs 1x Time Segment. You’ll fight spectral mobs, so try to bring weapons that deal extra damage to supernatural entities. These activities yield manuals for the Soul Reaping and Unholy Vitality perks, as well as various odds and ends like equipment, consumables, and silver. A map that shows the locations of Haunted Sites. Haunted Site #1: Site of Crucifixion Location: On a hilltop near the Eerie Knoll shrine. It’s also right next to an Ancient Circle. Reward: Unholy Vitality Manual Haunted Site #2: Mass Grave Location: Follow the road leading northeast out of Shrike’s Crag. Continue onward to the nearby woods just before a Tatzelwurm Lair. Rewards: Soul Reaping Manual and Tough Leather Boots (epic boots) The Site of Crucifixion (left) and Mass Grave (right). title: The Best Perks To Unlock And Upgrade In The Blood of Dawnwalker
description: Are you curious about the best perks in The Blood of Dawnwalker? This action RPG lets you play as both a human and a vampire. You also have different skill trees with powerful perks, often altering how you approach encounters. Our guide has several suggestions to help you with combat and exploration. In This Article The Blood of Dawnwalker - Swordmastery, Witchcraft, and Vampirism skill trees Best Swordmastery perks Swordmastery abilities: Swordmastery ultimate: Best Witchcraft perks Witchcraft abilities: Witchcraft ultimate: Best Vampirism perks Vampirism abilities: Vampirism ultimate: The Blood of Dawnwalker - Swordmastery, Witchcraft, and Vampirism skill trees Before we discuss the best perks in The Blood of Dawnwalker, let’s talk briefly about how you unlock and upgrade skills. Basically, you have three skill trees: Swordmastery - Your melee aptitude and physical prowess. Your abilities here can be used both in human form during the day and vampire form at night. Witchcraft - The Witchcraft tree has various perks related to spellcasting. Most are only applicable during the day. Vampirism - Your Vampirism skills emphasize sheer bloodthirstiness and lethality, including the use of claws to shred opponents. That said, these are only applicable at night. There are also two notable differences in how skills become available. For Swordmastery and Witchcraft, you need to obtain manuals that allow you to learn perks. For Vampirism, you have to increase your Corruption level by drinking more blood. Note: The vast majority of perks and abilities cost skill points and time segments to unlock and upgrade. Be mindful of Time Progression, especially since you only have 30 days to save Coen’s family. A lot of perks and abilities cause time to advance. Best Swordmastery perks Some of the best skills in The Blood of Dawnwalker are in the Swordmastery tree. You utilize your melee weapons as a human and as a vampire, which means you get the most benefit from the boons you unlock.…

title: How To Heal As A Vampire In The Blood of Dawnwalker
description: Are you trying to figure out how you can heal as a vampire in The Blood of Dawnwalker? You have new powers as a creature of the night, but you also need to be wary of your own insatiable thirst. Our guide has a few tips to help you stay alive when the sun goes down. In This Article Healing as a vampire in The Blood of Dawnwalker Voracious Bite Other healing-related skills and perks Consumables and restoratives Gear with healing passives Healing as a vampire in The Blood of Dawnwalker There are several ways to keep Coen in tip-top condition: Voracious Bite - Feed on your enemies. Other healing-related skills and perks. Consumables and restoratives. Gear with healing passives. Voracious Bite Voracious Bite is your go-to skill if you want to heal as a vampire in The Blood of Dawnwalker. It can actually be used in and out of combat: When used in combat, Voracious Bite deals damage based on its level in the Character - Vampirism panel. The skill uses one activation charge, and it cannot be interrupted once cast. To use Voracious Bite outside of combat, hold down the focus button and look for a target--i.e. humans, animals, or monsters like kobolds. Next, press the button prompt to teleport to that target, then hold it down to begin sucking on the blood of your victim. You can get interrupted if you get hit by an opponent’s attack. Note 1: Voracious Bite does not work on large creatures like bears and spectral creatures that don’t have blood. Note 2: The Nourishing Blood perk increases the amount that's healed whenever you drink blood. Chomp down on puny mortals. Other healing-related skills and perks Various abilities also help improve your survivability: Scarlet Shield - This restores a portion of your health segment whenever you do a perfect block. Endless Hunger, Closing Wounds, and Blood Theft - This column of perks ensures that you can continue to heal up while remaining on the offensive.
